question: Why did European FTD conversion deteriorate after July 15?

plan.question: Why did European FTD conversion deteriorate after July 15?

steps.purpose: Confirm required operational fields exist without using evaluation-only ground-truth columns.
Measure pre/post FTD conversion and response time for Europe Team A+B.
Measure the same metrics for other European teams.
Test whether the affected conversion and response-time shifts are statistically distinguishable.
Decompose Europe-wide FTD-rate change by sales team and rank negative contributors.
Compare post-change daily response-time medians against the robust pre-change baseline.
Check nearby business events for a plausible operational explanation.
Separate supported findings from causal overclaims.

claims.text: Affected Europe Team A+B FTD conversion changed by -7.53 percentage points after 2026-07-15.
Median response time in the affected cohort changed by 29.15 minutes.
The European control cohort conversion changed by -1.21 percentage points over the same split.
A CRM routing change is present in the nearby business-event log and is a supported root-cause candidate, not an automatically proven real-world causal conclusion.
Team A is the largest negative team-level contributor in the symmetric Europe FTD-rate decomposition (-1.87 pp contribution).
8 of 27 post-change daily response-time medians exceed the robust pre-change high-anomaly threshold.

nearby_business_events.description: A simulated CRM routing change increases lead-assignment latency for European Team A and Team B, reducing FTD conversion probability.

diagnosis.causal_language_guardrail: The evidence supports the CRM routing change as the primary root-cause candidate in this synthetic benchmark; a real deployment should not convert temporal association into a causal claim without additional design/validation.

parameters.sql: SELECT lead_created_at, region, assigned_team, response_time_minutes, converted_ftd FROM sales_activity WHERE region = 'Europe' AND assigned_team IN ('Team A', 'Team B') ORDER BY lead_created_at
SELECT lead_created_at, region, assigned_team, response_time_minutes, converted_ftd FROM sales_activity WHERE region = 'Europe' AND assigned_team NOT IN ('Team A', 'Team B') ORDER BY lead_created_at

SELECT assigned_team AS segment, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN converted_ftd THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successes, AVG(CASE WHEN converted_ftd THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS rate FROM sales_activity WHERE region = 'Europe' AND lead_created_at < '2026-07-15' GROUP BY assigned_team ORDER BY assigned_team

SELECT assigned_team AS segment, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN converted_ftd THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successes, AVG(CASE WHEN converted_ftd THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS rate FROM sales_activity WHERE region = 'Europe' AND lead_created_at >= '2026-07-15' GROUP BY assigned_team ORDER BY assigned_team
SELECT event_id, date, event_type, region, affected_team, description FROM business_events WHERE region = 'Europe' AND date >= '2026-07-10' AND date <= '2026-07-20 23:59:59' ORDER BY date

rows.description: A simulated CRM routing change increases lead-assignment latency for European Team A and Team B, reducing FTD conversion probability.
